directive.thread_id: film repository port 2026-11-05, lane film-tools: the thumbnail builder of a film
directive.quote: Finish the port of the film repository so it can be retired: move each job to its correct home, porting the correct parts one to one and never rebuilding from scratch what already worked; move the code byte for byte, then make what it fixed arguments and settings.

targets.baseline_commit_message: compose-thumbnails-from-layout-templates: a film's thumbnail builder, moved byte for byte

preserve: the six layout functions (split_claim, face_right_stack, zoom_flaw, tags, hold_quote, corner_face) with every number they fix
punch, crop_cover, sticker, place_cut, boxed, stroked, arrow, zoom_circle, tag and blurred_bg as they were
a cut-out is placed so its face box lands at the candidate's canvas point and height
allowed_deltas: the candidate table (CANDIDATES, the face boxes F and the zoom point) is the person's settings row, read with tools/settings request_settings; JSON lists become the tuples the templates use
the frames and cut-outs folders, the cut-out crop offset, the output folder and the font are request fields
zoom_flaw's zoomed spot is mapped from zoom_c through the cut-out's placement (the one candidate that had it computed the same numbers in a lambda)
one JSON request in, one answer out; a missing frame, value or candidate is refused in words
banned_substitutions: a candidate, face box or font path written in code
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it.
